title: Large-intersection limsup sets from uniformly bounded inhomogeneous dyadic energies converging to compactly supported non-atomic probability measures
author: Tomas Persson
work: Inhomogeneous potentials, Hausdorff dimension and shrinking targets
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 2 (2019), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.15
difficulty_reason: The author builds measure-adapted dyadic large-intersection classes and an inverse-potential Frostman construction, then closes weak-limit energy bounds through a nested content argument. This new inhomogeneous large-intersection criterion exceeds ordinary qualifying measure theory.
